Featured Sermon

He Picks The Kings and Keeps The Kingdoms

Nations rise and fall, but none of it surprises God. In this message from Romans 13, we're reminded that every throne is under His authority, and that we can rest in the One who holds the whole kingdom in His hands.

Rev. Lawrence Jackson, Jr.

Meet Our Pastor

Pastoral Leadership

Called to serve and rooted in the Word, shepherding The Mission with love and wisdom.

Pastor

Rev. Lawrence Jackson, Jr.

Rev. Jackson leads Free Mission Baptist Church in preaching, teaching, and caring for the congregation. He brings the Word every Sunday morning and guides the church through seasons like Lent, Homecoming, and its ongoing study of the Book of Hebrews.

His heart is for a church that reaches out, reflects Christ, and impacts lives far beyond Egania Street.

Our Mission & Vision

Our Mission & Vision

The heart of everything we do, and the future we're building together in the Ninth Ward.

Our Mission

To reach out to our community, reflect Christ in all we do, and impact lives with the hope of the Gospel.

What We Believe

Jesus Christ is the Son of God. He was crucified, died, rose again, and is seated at the right hand of the Father, interceding for all who trust Him.

Our Community

A beacon in the Historic Ninth Ward since 1956, and a church family where everyone is welcomed, known, and loved.
